CustomField.description: [??] - This is a URL created via a formula. Use this link to verify that the ID entered in the Queue or User ID field accurately identifies your desired Queue or User.
CustomField.formula: IF( LEN(Queue_ID__c) <> 15 || ( LEFT(Queue_ID__c,3) <> "005" && LEFT(Queue_ID__c,3) <> "00G" ) , "Enter a valid ID in the Queue or User ID field" , IF(LEFT(Queue_ID__c,3) = "005", HYPERLINK("/"&Queue_ID__c&"?noredirect=1","Click to View Associated User") , HYPERLINK("/p/own/Queue/d?id="&Queue_ID__c,"Click to View Associated Queue")) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is a URL created via a formula. Use this link to verify that the ID entered in the Queue or User ID field accurately identifies your desired Queue or User.
CustomField.label: Queue or User URL
